📐 Core Governing Equations
  • Chilled Water Temperatures: Standard design: Supply at $7^\circ$C ($44^\circ$F), Return at $12^\circ$C ($54^\circ$F), $\Delta T = 5^\circ$C.
  • Cooling Load Calculation: $TR = \frac{\dot{m} \times c_p \times \Delta T}{3.517}$
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • HVAC Components: Air Handling Unit (AHU), Fan Coil Unit (FCU), Variable Air Volume (VAV), Chiller, Cooling Tower.
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • Chilled water hydronic loops provide precise temperature and zoning control in high-rise buildings.

Module 2.title: Electrical Distribution: Transformers & Switchgear
Module 2.diagram_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 500 130' style='width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px auto;display:block;'><text x='20' y='25' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13' font-weight='bold'>Building Electrical Distribution Single Line Diagram (SLD)</text><text x='90' y='75' fill='#fcd34d' font-size='13'>11kV Grid → Step-Down Transformer → Main LT Panel → Sub-DB → MCB/ELCB</text></svg>
Module 2.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary • 24ESP507 Module 2
📐 Core Governing Equations
  • MCB vs ELCB/RCCB: MCB protects against overload and short circuits; RCCB/ELCB protects humans against residual leakage current ($\le 30$ mA).
  • Three-Phase Power: $P = \sqrt{3} V_L I_L \cos\phi$ (Line voltage 415 V, phase voltage 230 V)
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • Earthing Standards: Pipe earthing, plate earthing, chemical earthing; earth resistance must be $< 1$ Ohm for sub-stations, $< 5$ Ohms for domestic.
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) seamlessly switches from grid power to diesel generator (DG) backup within 10-15 seconds.

Module 3.title: Plumbing: Water Supply, Drainage & Fixtures
Module 3.diagram_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 500 130' style='width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px auto;display:block;'><text x='20' y='25' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13' font-weight='bold'>Plumbing Two-Pipe Drainage System</text><text x='90' y='75' fill='#10b981' font-size='13'>Soil Pipe (Blackwater) + Waste Pipe (Greywater) + Vent Pipe (Trap Seal)</text></svg>
Module 3.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary • 24ESP507 Module 3
📐 Core Governing Equations
  • Drainage Systems: One-pipe vs Two-pipe systems; Soil pipe handles water closets/urinals; Waste pipe handles washbasins/kitchen sinks.
  • P-Trap / Water Seal: Maintains 50-75 mm water barrier preventing toxic sewer gases and pests from entering living spaces.
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • Hydro-Pneumatic Pumping System: Pressurized booster pump system delivering constant water pressure to upper floors of high-rise towers.
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • Vent pipes prevent siphonage of water seals during rapid drainage surges.

Module 4.title: Fire Protection: Sprinklers & Hydrant Networks
Module 4.diagram_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 500 130' style='width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px auto;display:block;'><text x='20' y='25' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13' font-weight='bold'>Fire Fighting Wet Pipe Sprinkler System</text><text x='90' y='75' fill='#ef4444' font-size='13'>Fire Ring Main (7 bar) → Jockey Pump → Main Fire Pump → Sprinkler Bulbs (68°C)</text></svg>
Module 4.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary • 24ESP507 Module 4
📐 Core Governing Equations
  • Automatic Fire Sprinkler: Heat-sensitive quartz glass bulb filled with liquid bursting at rated temperature (Standard Red bulb: $68^\circ$C / $155^\circ$F).
  • Fire Pumping Array: Jockey pump (maintains standing pressure, e.g. 7-8 bar) + Main electric fire pump + Diesel engine backup pump.
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • Fire Classes (NFPA): Class A (combustibles), Class B (flammable liquids), Class C (energized electrical), Class D (metals), Class K (cooking oils).
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • NFPA 13 and NBC (National Building Code of India Part 4) mandate sprinkler spacing based on hazard classifications.
Module 4.detailed_notes:
Comprehensive Engineering Analysis • Life Safety & Fire Suppression

Hydraulic Sizing of Fire Networks

Sizing wet riser pipes, landing valves, fire department siamese connections, and clean agent (FM-200 / Novec 1230) gas flooding systems for server rooms.

Module 5.title: MEP Coordinated Drawings & BIM Modeling
Module 5.diagram_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 500 130' style='width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px auto;display:block;'><text x='20' y='25' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13' font-weight='bold'>BIM 3D MEP Clash Detection Matrix</text><text x='80' y='75' fill='#f59e0b' font-size='13'>HVAC Ducts ⚡ Cable Trays ⚡ Fire Sprinkler Pipes ⚡ Structural Beams</text></svg>
Module 5.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary • 24ESP507 Module 5
📐 Core Governing Equations
  • Building Information Modeling (BIM): 3D parametric model containing geometric, spatial, and functional engineering data (Revit MEP, Navisworks).
  • Clash Detection: Hard clash (physical geometric intersection, e.g. duct through beam); Soft clash (insufficient maintenance clearance).
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • Shop Drawings vs As-Built Drawings: Shop drawings guide on-site installation; As-built drawings document actual installed locations after construction handover.
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • Coordination hierarchy: Large gravity drain pipes have slope priority, followed by large HVAC ducts, then pressurized water pipes, and flexible electrical conduit.
Module 5.detailed_notes:
